_comment: Single source of truth for the demand-response assumptions.
Read by BOTH src/lib/scenario.ts (the UI and API) and scripts/agent.py (the
proposal engine). They must never diverge: if the agent quantified a price
change with different elasticities from the ones the app explains a number
with, the two would contradict each other on screen. Keeping them in one
file rather than duplicating the constants in each language is the point.
These are ASSUMPTIONS, not per-series fitted estimates. They are also the
assumptions the dataset was generated from, so simulation stays coherent
with the driver attribution. A production deployment would estimate a price
elasticity per series from its own price history and interval it.
